Abdulkerim Bardakci.note: Watch Bardakcı for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Abdulkerim Bardakci.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Altay Bayindir.note: Bayındır stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Altay Bayindir.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Arda Guler.note: Güler is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Arda Guler.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Baris Alper Yilmaz.note: Yılmaz's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward.
Baris Alper Yilmaz.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。

Caglar Soyuncu.note: Söyüncü's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Caglar Soyuncu.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢上。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Can Uzun.summary: Can Uzun is a Türkiye attacking midfielder from Eintracht Frankfurt who gives the national team between-lines receiving, sharp shooting, and young creative upside.
Can Uzun.note: Uzun's signature is receiving in tight spaces with his next action already planned. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Can Uzun.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在狭小空间接球前就想好下一步上。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Deniz Gul.note: Gül's signature is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Deniz Gul.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在等防守者注意力转移后再启动上。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Eren Elmali.note: Elmalı is defined by making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Eren Elmali.noteZh: 他靠在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Ferdi Kadioglu.note: Kadıoğlu stands out for creating a better angle for the next pass. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Ferdi Kadioglu.noteZh: 他的突出特点是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Hakan Calhanoglu.note: Çalhanoğlu's edge is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Hakan Calhanoglu.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Irfan Can Kahveci.summary: İrfan Can Kahveci is a Türkiye right winger from Kasımpaşa who gives the national team left-footed crossing, combination play, and set-piece quality.
Irfan Can Kahveci.note: Kahveci's edge is delivering the ball without needing much space. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Irfan Can Kahveci.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在很小空间里也能送出传中的能力。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Ismail Yuksek.note: Yüksek's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Ismail Yuksek.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢上。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Kaan Ayhan.note: Ayhan stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Kaan Ayhan.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Kenan Yildiz.note: Yıldız stands out for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Kenan Yildiz.noteZh: 他的突出特点是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Kerem Akturkoglu.note: Aktürkoğlu's signature is explosive speed once open grass appears. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Kerem Akturkoglu.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在看到空当后的爆发速度上。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Merih Demiral.note: Demiral stands out for reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Merih Demiral.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Mert Gunok.note: Watch Günok for staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Mert Gunok.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。留意他如何在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Mert Muldur.summary: Mert Müldür is a Türkiye right-back from Fenerbahçe who gives the national team full-back defending, recovery speed, and back-post coverage.
Mert Muldur.note: Müldür's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.
Mert Muldur.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。

Oguz Aydin.summary: Oğuz Aydın is a Türkiye right winger from Fenerbahçe who gives the national team one-on-one dribbling, acceleration, and direct crossing.
Oguz Aydin.note: Aydın's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Oguz Aydin.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在变向时仍把球控制在脚下上。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Orkun Kokcu.summary: Orkun Kökçü is a Türkiye central midfielder from Beşiktaş who gives the national team progressive passing, midfield shooting, and press-resistant control.
Orkun Kokcu.note: Watch Kökçü for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Orkun Kokcu.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Ozan Kabak.summary: Ozan Kabak is a Türkiye centre-back from TSG Hoffenheim who gives the national team aggressive duels, aerial defending, and recovery cover.
Ozan Kabak.note: Kabak's edge is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Ozan Kabak.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Salih Ozcan.summary: Salih Özcan is a Türkiye defensive midfielder from Borussia Dortmund who gives the national team screening, duels, and disciplined possession support.
Salih Ozcan.note: Özcan's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Salih Ozcan.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Samet Akaydin.note: Akaydin's edge is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Samet Akaydin.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Ugurcan Cakir.summary: Uğurcan Çakır is a Türkiye goalkeeper from Galatasaray who gives the national team shot stopping, penalty-area command, and long distribution.
Ugurcan Cakir.note: Çakır's signature is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Ugurcan Cakir.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在提前站位后的快速反应上。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Yunus Akgun.note: Akgün's signature is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Yunus Akgun.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在比防线早一步看到决定性的传球上。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Zeki Celik.note: Çelik is defined by protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Zeki Celik.noteZh: 他靠先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。
